description: Fires when the opponent threatens to win in column 6 (rightmost), mainly when they have three stones stacked vertically on top of column 6 with the cell above empty (strongest for a stack at rows 0-2). A non-vertical must-block in column 6 above the bottom row fires weakly. Does not fire for a bottom-row horizontal threat at column 6, stacks in other columns, or my own column-6 stack (strongly negative).
effect: Raises the probability of playing column 6 (blocking the stack), e.g. +0.21 in one position (0.77 to 0.97), taking it from columns 3/4. Barely changes anything when the model already blocks with near certainty.
notes: p1 (vertical O-three in col 6 only): F1 0.446, P 0.90, R 0.30. Adding 'opponent stacked two in col 6' (p2) hurt precision: F1 0.38. p3/p4 (vertical three, or any col-6 must-block at row>=1): F1 0.501, P 0.69, R 0.39, AUROC 0.69, sim share 0.05. Act tests: col-6 specific (col 0/5 stacks ~0); horizontal (0,6) threat ~0; full column ~0; my own col-6 three about -7. About 60% of firing is a diffuse weak band (0.8-2.5), often right after the opponent plays column 6, with no consistent rule found. Synthesis beat dev max (17.65 vs 17.63).
